pricing.faq1q: What happens when I run out of AI credits?
pricing.faq1a: On the Free plan, you get 20 credits as a one-time trial. On Pro and Growth plans, credits reset monthly. You can top up anytime or upgrade your plan.
pricing.faq2q: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
pricing.faq2a: Yes. You can cancel or downgrade anytime with no penalties. Your subscription continues until the end of the current billing period.
pricing.faq3q: Do you support Arabic and RTL?
pricing.faq3a: Yes. The entire platform is fully bilingual (English + Arabic) with proper right-to-left support and beautiful Arabic typography.
pricing.faq4q: How accurate is the ranking data?
pricing.faq4a: We fetch live, authentic search results from local Google Play servers in the USA, Saudi Arabia, UAE, and India — giving you highly relevant data for your target markets.
pricing.faq5q: Do you support regional tracking for India and SEA?
pricing.faq5a: Yes. We provide localized SERP data for India, ensuring your ASO strategy matches the largest Android user base on earth. Support for more SEA countries is coming soon.
pricing.faq6a: Yes. With Competitor Spy, you can analyze competitors' keywords, find ranking gaps, and discover quick wins using your monthly credits.
pricing.bottomSubtitle: Upgrade anytime to unlock more credits and apps.
pricing.trustCtaLine: No credit card required • Cancel anytime • Data secure

exportModal.title: Ready to Paste in Google Play Console
exportModal.intro: Blocks below match Play’s character caps. Follow the steps, then paste into Main store listing.
exportModal.step1: Open Google Play Console → your app → Grow → Store presence → Main store listing.
exportModal.step2: Copy each field with Copy, or use the green “Copy All for Play Console” button to copy App Name, Short Description, and Full Description in one step.
exportModal.step3: Paste into the matching fields in Play Console: App name, Short description, and Full description.
exportModal.step4: Check character counts in Play Console, tweak wording if needed, then save.
exportModal.tipOpenConsoleTab: Tip: Open Google Play Console in another tab for easy copy-paste.
exportModal.copyToast: Copied! Now paste in Google Play Console → {field}

accounts.title: Admin · Financial accounts
accounts.subtitle: Private dashboard. Aggregates from Supabase via `admin_financial_snapshot` (RLS + admin flag). No `payments` table yet — revenue is $0 until Stripe charge rows exist.
accounts.paymentsGap: No payments table in schema — gross revenue is $0. Wire Stripe webhook totals here when available.
accounts.creditsNote: All-time credits: purchased vs spent from `credits_ledger` (see totals in export JSON).
accounts.chartTitle: Last 30 days · Revenue vs estimated AI cost
accounts.noAuthUidMessage: No signed-in user was found. Sign in before opening this page.
accounts.forbiddenPrivilegeMessage: User is authenticated but lacks Admin privileges in the profiles table.
accounts.loadError: The page route exists, but `admin_financial_snapshot` returned an error (code: {code}).
accounts.loadErrorHint: Apply pending Supabase migrations (see `admin_financial_snapshot` RPC), check Supabase logs, and confirm your profile has admin access in the database.
accounts.forbiddenBulletMigrations: Apply migrations in order: `supabase db push` (or run SQL files by timestamp under `supabase/migrations/`).
accounts.forbiddenSqlSnippet: update public.profiles set is_admin = true, role = 'admin' where id = '<uuid from auth.users>';
accounts.forbiddenBulletAuthUid: The RPC uses `auth.uid()` — you must update the row where `profiles.id` matches the signed-in user.
accounts.forbiddenBulletGrantExecute: If you still see permission errors (not this JSON `forbidden`), ensure `GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.admin_financial_snapshot(date, date) TO authenticated` is applied (see migrations).
